_comment: `route.js` and `helper.js` form a deferred group: `helper.js` has no init wrapper, and its body runs in the wrapper of `route.js`. `lazy.js` is also in the closure of `route.js`, but only a conditional `require()` evaluates it. Thus it keeps its own wrapper, and the group does not run it: after `read(false)`, `lazy.js` did not run.
